integrity: The proof uses a dimension-free exact projector identity and strong convexity. Exact-rational checker tests concrete identities but is not a substitute for the analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires a fixed orthogonal splitting and globally separable energy E(u,v)=-f(u)+g(v), with both f and g uniformly strongly convex.
Only the position component of continuous high-index saddle dynamics is treated; no stability statement is made for coupled eigenspace estimation, momentum variants, or discretizations.
The threshold is optimal for a universal guarantee, not a necessary stability criterion for each individual potential or projector.
Historical priority is provisional; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp global forty-five-degree robustness of inexact high-index saddle flows
